title: Northgate Purchases & Returns Business Accounts Reference: Route Pickup Fee Invoicing
content:
## Scope of the rule

On a Northgate Purchases & Returns purchase whose presenting membership is a Northgate Business Membership or a Northgate Business Plus Membership, the changed-mind freight pickup of special-order merchandise is invoiced by member services as a route pickup fee. The fee is entered as one return pickup fee entry against the sale line of the return authorization awaiting the member's confirmation, when the member asks to confirm that authorization. A purchase presented on any other membership is outside this rule.

| Purchase presented on | Changed-mind freight pickup of special-order merchandise |
|---|---|
| Northgate Business Membership | invoiced by member services as a route pickup fee |
| Northgate Business Plus Membership | invoiced by member services as a route pickup fee |
| any other membership | outside this rule |

## The invoicing tool: `invoice_route_pickup_fee_16b23a12`

**Capability.** The tool invoices the route pickup fee on a business member's purchase: member services books, against the sale line whose merchandise the freight crew will collect, one return pickup fee entry for the amount given, dated today, and raises the purchase's net paid amount by that amount. The invoice then appears in the purchase's line history as a return pickup fee pointing at that sale line, and the fee is standing on the purchase.

**How it is invoked.** This is a member services tool: the agent unlocks `invoice_route_pickup_fee_16b23a12` and then calls it on the agent side.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `order_id` | the purchase reference number of the business member's purchase the fee is invoiced on, read from the purchase lookup | identifier |
| `source_order_line_id` | the reference number of the sale line the freight crew will collect, read from the return authorization (its sale line) or from the purchase line lookup | identifier |
| `route_pickup_fee` | the route pickup fee to invoice, in USD | a positive amount with 2 decimal places (cents); a value with more decimals is rounded half up to 2 decimal places at booking |

**Return.** A receipt with `fee_entry_id` (the reference number of the new fee entry), `fee_type` (always `return_pickup_fee`), `amount` (the invoiced fee in USD, 2 decimal places), `event_date` (the booking date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `net_paid_amount` (the purchase's net paid amount after the invoice, USD, 2 decimal places). The presence of `fee_entry_id` indicates the invoice was booked.

Hypothetical receipt shape: a fee of 109.00 on a purchase whose net paid amount was 2400.00 returns an amount of 109.00 and a net paid amount of 2509.00, with a new fee entry reference.
